human_scope.summary: Functional runnable proxy with mandatory explicitly installed/versioned/startup-checked Pandoc and exact original spans; strict independent acceptance; all unapproved slices preserved; NO separate human evaluation dataset (excluded, not deferred); linguistic benefit/harm/99% goals remain unmeasured; no research restart, no package programme, no new milestone gate; only the existing foreground coding agent; offline audit, no target calls.

proposals_vs_agreement_note: Per PLAN §1.2 and §12: library choices, JSON field names, numeric limits, module names and work splits are implementation proposals, not additional agreed requirements; they are recorded here only where they define auditable behavior (finite limits, module boundaries, test duty). Agreement rows are the binding product requirements.

requirements.requirement: Complete main generation and bounded capture BEFORE any CPU review, repair inference or delivery of answer text; the user never sees provisional original text while repair is pending.

Upstream completion must be verified per the explicitly supported upstream protocol (e.g. finish semantics), not by socket closure alone; a partial/truncated main answer must not enter the successful CAPTURED path as if complete.

Initial API path is one explicitly supported nonstreaming text shape with one response choice; unsupported request capabilities are rejected before the main call or routed through an explicitly configured unchanged bypass; no silent JSON masquerading as SSE; internal upstream streaming may be bounded-captured but completion is validated before CPU analysis; no provisional content in progress/heartbeat.
Exceeding the hard capture limit is a bounded API failure: truncated text is never labelled complete or delivered as a successful answer.
requirements.source: PLAN §13.3 (hard capture limit row); ARCH §14.2; A-FAIL-01

requirements.requirement: CPU evidence selects whether review is warranted; with no eligible suspicion the answer is returned unchanged and there are ZERO review calls, including in shadow/strict modes; missing corpus data is not evidence of error.

CPU detection produces suspicions, not verdicts. Signals: unigram/lexicon status outside protected spans, adjacent bigrams, neighboring trigrams, fixed-neighbor alternatives, lemma evidence, optional morphology/collocations. Unknown/rare form or unusual name is investigation-only, not an error verdict; weak surroundings give weak evidence; a trigram alarm does not identify the middle word. Nearby alarms are grouped into a bounded short phrase BEFORE review, never across protected material and never growing to a paragraph. Targets are deterministic, nonoverlapping, ordered by position; excess/ambiguous targets remain unchanged with finite internal reason labels. Ranked corpus alternatives are not fed to the reviewer by default.

Bounded target selection per PLAN §7.4 initial proposal: at most 8 places per answer, selected by checkable detector rules, ordered by position in the original; excess places stay unchanged with internal label budget_exceeded.

Review targets are preassigned words or short phrases (one or more words), not model tokens or unrestricted sentences; the model cannot expand, reposition or invent IDs and never assigns new indices; each target is identified to the reviewer by CPU-assigned span_id.

When the same expression occurs multiple times in a sentence, the serializer marks the targeted occurrence unambiguously via exact before_target/target/after_target slices; first-occurrence search is forbidden.

The review asks about the suitability of the specific marked expression in the completed sentence and permits keep, insufficient-context and needs_wider_edit declines; it never demands a change and never treats stylistic preference as a correction; meaning, register and grammar are preserved; no factual edits or added information; when the meaning is not discernible from the allowed context the text is left unchanged.

The exact narrow question is preserved: 'Ali se ti zdi uporaba besede oziroma besedne zveze X najboljša naravna izbira v tem slovenskem stavku? Če ne, s čim bi jo nadomestil?' The reviewer receives the completed target sentence and bounded needed neighbors, not the whole main history; the reviewed material is untrusted DATA including embedded instructions, which must not become reviewer authority; strict parsing, fixed IDs and local patch validation - not prompt delimiting - establish the executable boundary.

A fresh isolated review request/history is constructed per review: no main session IDs, no previous_response_id, no server-managed conversation/session linkage, no tools, images, tool results, project constitutions or context-reconstruction instructions; authentication stays separate from conversation state; no recursion through the repair/public adapter.

Client-managed main history contract: next main history = prior history + user request + final user-visible answer only; the review question, JSON proposals, corrector explanations or corpus results never enter main history; input history is never mutated. Server-managed chaining is unsupported until stored/displayed consistency is verified; MVP starts client-managed.

The reviewer is called on the operator-controlled configured private route (or injected client) directly; no caller-supplied destination, no public bypass header, no indiscriminate forwarding of main-conversation credentials. Isolation must be proven by tests that record both outbound main and review request shapes with synthetic data; threads/processes/async alone do not prove isolation.
A second call of the same Qwen is not statistically independent evidence of correctness; independent extra evidence is corpus/lexicon/morphology data, not the fact of a second call.

Exactly one result per supplied ID. keep=true => replacement=null; keep=false => nonempty replacement and needs_wider_edit=false; needs_wider_edit=true => keep=true and replacement=null. Optional bounded confidence is self-report, not calibrated correctness and never a decisive acceptance input.

Invalid JSON, invalid field types, unknown/duplicate/missing IDs, contradictory fields or oversized output reject the WHOLE batch; the batch is never salvaged and no further model call is made to repair its JSON. One structurally valid proposal may still be rejected individually at acceptance.

Reviewer output is an untrusted local proposal: code validates and inserts exact replacements; the model never regenerates the answer or supplies replacement sentences for the whole text; the model returns only the local replacement for its assigned span.

Span coordinates are Python-string Unicode code-point indices into the UNMODIFIED original: 0 <= start < end <= len(text); text[start:end] == original slice; span_id unique within the response; selected spans do not intersect protected material. Not UTF-8 bytes, UTF-16 units or model tokens; any future conversion is explicit and tested. Normalization/casefold only on derived lookup views. Combining marks/emoji/CRLF require explicit tests; unsafe partial-grapheme targets abstain.

All original substrings outside accepted spans are preserved exactly: protected content, whitespace, line endings, diacritics, formatting, punctuation. No reserialization, detokenization or Markdown re-rendering substitutes for the original. If no edit survives, the returned text is EXACTLY the original text.

The original stays immutable until final composition. Each selected original slice is rechecked immediately before applying; overlapping/incompatible edits are rejected (no silent last-wins). The result is composed from untouched original slices plus approved replacements (or an equivalently tested descending-offset implementation). After composition, affected sentences are rechecked; mutually conflicting nearby changes are rolled back as a conflict group and rebuilt from the original. This is bounded CPU validation, never a new generative pass.

Text equality differs from HTTP byte equality: on a true unchanged pass-through the original envelope bytes are preserved where possible; on a changed path only the explicitly supported envelope transformation is serialized and affected metadata is accounted for explicitly.

Only explicitly supported assistant-text fields are eligible; no recursive repair of every string in a response object. Tool/function fields, model/response IDs, schemas, structured JSON output, reasoning fields, images and binary data are uneditable; the initial adapter bypasses entire responses containing tool calls or unsupported structures.

Within eligible text, protected: fenced and indented code blocks, inline code, URLs and link destinations, email addresses, filesystem paths, commands, numbers and units, citations/quotes and other machine-significant strings. Proper names, titles, technical terms and mixed languages require conservative exclusion or a bounded terminology policy; unclear Markdown abstains rather than guessing.

Protected intervals are linguistic-context boundaries: removing them must not manufacture artificial bigram/trigram adjacency between the neighboring text; corpus context bounds stop at protected material. Markdown parsing may locate spans, but rendering Markdown anew cannot patch originals.

EXACT, CENSORED and UNAVAILABLE evidence semantics are preserved per record: EXACT = count known for this query and its declared scope, EXACT(0) only when source completeness justifies zero; CENSORED = only a threshold/range-derived bound is justified, missing does NOT mean zero; UNAVAILABLE = the source/query cannot support an interpretable value, so abstain. Missing truncated data is never converted to zero by a default value.

The complete context denominator is separately marked known/unknown; sums of retained n-grams are never presented as the full denominator; censored surface-form aggregation is not a complete lemma distribution. Comparisons require compatible source scope, normalization and units; valid conservative count-ratio bounds (e.g. (candidate_count_lower+alpha)/(original_count_upper+alpha)) may inform evidence but are not semantic proof and not calibrated acceptance rules; different-length phrase raw counts alone cannot authorize an edit; no fabricated probability distributions, entropies or guaranteed candidate dominance from partial trigram sums.

Corpus sources (Gigafida frequencies/n-grams, Sloleks, collocations, linguistic analyzers) are candidates to qualify, not bundled data or current-access claims. The reported ~2-per-million n-gram cutoff of one release is a warning, never a universal hardcoded threshold. Every imported index carries a manifest: source identity/version, acquisition reference/checksum, rights/license, format, cutoff/completeness, normalization/tagging, importer version and deterministic build parameters. Attribution/redistribution conditions are preserved; public query access is not bulk permission. Sparse available records only; candidate-middle-word indexes keep the same uncertainty metadata; no runtime scraping; large indexes/weights/private corpora stay out of Git; miniature fixtures are clearly labelled synthetic.

Lexical misuse and morphological disagreement are kept separate. Required morphological agreement is derived from context and analysis confidence, not by blindly copying the tags of a possibly-wrong original form; ambiguous lemma/tagging evidence may cause abstention. Strongly suspicious form with well-supported lemma suggests inflection error, not lexeme choice.

Strict acceptance requires appropriate INDEPENDENT corpus/lexicon/morphology evidence and no detected contradiction; frequency alone or model self-reported confidence alone cannot authorize a change; a second call of the same Qwen is not statistically independent evidence (covered with ISO-4).

Strict (AUTO_REPAIR) acceptance requires ALL applicable conditions: CPU-selected target; valid local proposal; target equality and non-protected bounds; finite structure/size limits; appropriate independent corpus/lexicon/morphology evidence; no detected contextual or semantic contradiction; valid composed result. Neutral/incomparable data is insufficient; identity replacements are rejected; forbidden newlines/control/markup/code structure, overlong replacements and scope expansion are rejected; adjacent punctuation is never normalized as an unreported side effect.

Evidence rules vary by error class: a malformed form may rely on valid-form/orthographic/context evidence; replacing one valid lexeme with another needs stronger contextual support. Multi-word replacements must not be judged by raw whole-phrase frequency comparison across different lengths: affected local contexts, morphology and (where available) collocations are checked; non-comparable support means strict abstention. More frequent is not automatically more correct; harmful semantic edits remain part of mandatory evaluation.

Operational modes with exact behavior: detect_only (CPU only, no review, no change); shadow (eligible review/scoring, original delivered, results only via approved evaluation); strict (validated AUTO_REPAIR only applied); experimental (future explicitly configured/evaluated, never auto-enabled, not required for MVP). Development sequence: detect_only -> shadow -> measured limited strict.

LLM_CONFIRMED_REPAIR (corpus flags, Qwen replaces, further corpus neutral/insufficient) remains DISABLED for automatic user-text changes in the MVP; it may be studied in shadow evaluation only. Enabling later requires separate measured quality and a stricter policy, not a higher confidence threshold; explicit negative evidence must never be replaced by 'corpus has no data'.

Initial configurable engineering defaults (not measured optima): <=1 review request per response; 1 generative pass; 0 automatic retries; <=1 concurrent review request from this component; <=8 targets per response; target normally <=6 words plus finite character bound; replacement <=8 words plus finite character bound; automatic evidence-insufficient acceptance disabled; automatic persistent text storage disabled. Finite bounds are selected for capture bytes, analysis length, context per target, total prompt/output size, queue length/wait and total review time; the policy version is recorded; no fabricated target-machine throughput.

Full failure contract: no eligible suspicion -> original, zero review calls; corpus missing/corrupt/incompatible -> degraded original with internal label, no invented counts; analysis size exceeded after safe capture -> original without analysis; review queue full/timeout/transport failure/invalid batch -> cancel owned optional work and return completed original; individual proposal failure -> reject that proposal only; composed conflict -> rollback conflict group; main error/incomplete -> honest protocol error/finish semantics, no repair; hard capture limit -> bounded API failure; client disconnect -> cancel owned upstream/review work, stop delivery, no orphan repair. Optional fallback never bypasses auth/validation/hard limits/isolation; internal reasons use a finite safe vocabulary.
Bounded one-pass initial review: at most one combined review request per answer and no automatic generative repair/retry loop, including malformed-JSON repair by the model; CPU revalidation only.
Optional repair failure preserves only the already safely captured original; main errors, incompleteness and hard capture limits are never masked as successful output.

The existing Qwen is reused through the authorized client; the CPU-side repair infrastructure must not load a second large GPU model, must not alter the protected deployment/resources (weights/quantization, vLLM/CUDA, launch flags, ports, gateway), and makes no claim that one Python thread creates GPU capacity.

Main generation and review for one answer are strictly sequential; the repair path uses a bounded queue and must not indefinitely starve main requests; no two concurrent model sequences are required by the design.

Start from one verified nonstreaming text shape/choice with the actual endpoint/schema selected and tested in the order; no universal Chat/Responses compatibility claim. Unknown response structures are unmodified; no JSON masquerading as SSE; no rewriting of tool results; no accidental public bypass of internal controls. Future delayed SSE must synthesize a valid, consistent final event sequence with separate tests and makes no first-content latency claim; all final events carry the same repaired text.

Client-managed next main turn contains the final delivered answer only (covered with ISO-2). Changed text invalidates token-aligned probabilities and potentially offsets/annotations: such repair capabilities are initially rejected/bypassed under the declared capability policy; stale logprobs are never silently kept or fabricated. Main-generation usage and review usage are recorded separately; recounting tokens of the final string measures neither bill; review cost is visible to the operator without misrepresenting upstream usage.

Production logs contain no user text, target/replacement strings, prompts, raw API responses or secrets; metrics use bounded counters, durations, policy/source versions and a finite reason vocabulary; the evaluation channel is separate and explicitly authorized; private text is never a metric label, exposed cache key or report excerpt.

Main output, review output, local evaluation files and downloaded corpus content are treated as data: embedded instructions/paths/URLs/code are never executed; the reviewer has no tools, no URL execution, no file-writing or conversation-mutation authority; credentials stay outside Git and are referenced without logging values; no unnecessary cross-user text caching; protected environment resources (Qwen service, model/quantization files, vLLM/CUDA, launch flags, ports, shared GPU, gateway, neighboring adapters) are not mutated by any ordinary product action.

Synthetic deterministic product tests across all required areas: capture completion/error/truncation; exact main/review shapes with no sharing/linkage/recursion; repeated substrings/Unicode/combining marks/emoji/CRLF/Markdown; protected boundaries and no artificial adjacency; exact zero vs censored absence, unknown denominator, incompatible scope; keep/replace/wider-edit/injection/malformed IDs/JSON/oversize; common-but-wrong, style-only, weak evidence, morphology, phrase-length; overlap/stale offsets/nearby conflicts/untouched equality; zero/one review calls, bounded queue, timeout, cancellation, request separation, no raw logging; supported envelope/finish/usage/history. Bootstrap governance tests do not substitute for product tests; live tests are opt-in, small, and qualify endpoint/model/capabilities/cancellation/usage without host changes; a skipped live test is not a pass.

Before any real-Qwen connection: verify model identifier, supported API shape, thinking/structured-output rules, a valid cancellation method and actual usage; documented state of a historical installation is not a substitute for that qualification test. Synthetic fake-upstream success does not establish Qwen quality or serving compatibility.

Software correctness, serving compatibility, linguistic benefit and deployment/release authority are separate evidence layers; goals and defaults are not measurements. The ~99% accepted-edit precision and <=1 harmful edit per 10,000 originally correct words are calibration goals, not results or release permission; zero observed harms in a small/clustered sample proves no zero rate (~3/N upper-bound orientation); useful benefit AND bounded harm are both required; mostly-abstaining implementations are not automatically successful.

Linguistic evaluation method (when performed): real target-model outputs with correct/rare/technical negative controls; human labels distinguishing error from stylistic preference from acceptable alternative; frozen calibration/held-out split without leakage/tuning; Qwen is never the final judge of its own changes; comparisons include original, corpus-detector-only, direct Qwen proofreading baseline and the agreed limited procedure; report accepted-edit precision, harmful edits per 10k correct words, style edits, detector vs repaired coverage, call rate, separate usage, latency/resource/failure, sample sizes and uncertainty.

Independent fresh architecture-to-current-main audit (ICA) is required before any MVP/release/closure claim: classifications IMPLEMENTED/PARTIAL/ABSENT/UNPROVEN with real paths/tests/SHA; reports are claims until corroborated; a green test exercising a replacement of the boundary under test cannot certify the real boundary; the audit does not merge or authorize deployment; strategy recommends, human decides the milestone label.

First product = completed Slovenian natural-language responses with conservative malformed-form, morphology and contextual word/short-phrase repair. Excluded: factual correction, translation, whole-answer rewriting, generated-file/tool/code editing, self-training, live token repair. General proofreading may exist only as an explicit evaluation baseline. Motivating examples are not hardcoded; not all errors are assumed quantization-caused; unknown terminology, ambiguous language, insufficient support or unsafe mapping -> abstain; demonstrate benefit despite abstention, never weaken gates to inflate edit counts.

The library accepts completed text and owns no conversation store or HTTP gateway; the reviewer dependency is injectable for deterministic offline tests. The adapter owns main capture/delivery; the reviewer owns one fresh outbound request; CPU workers own bounded analysis only. Each response has an immutable original, request-local analysis, selected targets, at most one batch, decisions and one final result; no shared mutable history or buffers; main and review are sequential per answer; cancellation targets only request-owned work.

Engineering baseline: Python 3.12 with locked uv environment, typed validated contracts, HTTPX for the review request, pytest with fake upstreams; FastAPI only for the later narrow adapter; dependency compatibility verified before pinning; no current CLI/model/server compatibility claimed from a historical example; sparse read-only SQLite indexes initially unless measured otherwise; optional CPU analyzers bounded with no uncontrolled index/analyzer copies; no import-time downloads or network calls.

The existing gateway keeps public authentication, route rights, quotas and public accounting; the local-coding project is separate and unmodified. The isolated review uses an operator-controlled private direct endpoint or injected client; never public repair recursion, never a caller-supplied destination, never a public bypass header, no indiscriminate forwarding of main credentials; internal diagnostic correlation does not create conversation linkage; no neighbor edits or cutover are implied; the repair layer separately evidences its additional usage.

Concentrated OAP governance: one current full architecture, no private PLAN/ARCH/CRITICAL mirrors, historical seeds immutable, ordered source evolution updates full source/projections/map together against the trusted accepted base, private strategic refresh only at post-merge quiescence, DHA exact-human-gate ownership.
PLAN §16.1: the entire main answer is captured before the repair call and before any user display.
PLAN §16.2: without sufficient suspicion there is no additional Qwen call.
PLAN §16.3: Qwen may propose only a replacement of its assigned span or answer 'keep'.
PLAN §16.4: the main conversation history contains no repair conversation or its internal results.
PLAN §16.5: no change happens outside programmatically validated spans.
PLAN §16.6: an invalid proposal or cancellation of the optional process does not damage the already completed answer.
PLAN §16.7: published truncated frequencies are not treated as complete statistics.

PLAN §16.8: a transparent report of benefit, harm, latency and additional usage exists (the reporting mechanism and the honest unmeasured status are the auditable parts; the quality measurement itself is owner-excluded in this order).
D01 Contracts and policy: clear span, evidence, proposal, decision and result structures; keep and replace separated.
D02 Bounded data import: reproducible index of initial sources with manifest and correct missing-data semantics (EXACT/CENSORED/UNAVAILABLE).
D03 Protection and mapping: tokenization without altering the original; tests for code, URLs and Unicode.
D04 First CPU detector: selects plausible suspicious places on a small set; does not send everything to the model.
D05 Isolated reviewer: fake and real Qwen clients both return validated local decisions.
D06 Acceptance and patcher: code accepts or rejects proposals and preserves all other slices exactly.
D07 CLI and first inspection: shows original, proposals, final text and reasons; real examples are not hardwired special cases.
M01 Initial labelled set: real target responses, correct control cases and a separate threshold-calibration part.
